latest.notes:
Songs now move further day to day.

Settings ▸ Scheduling ▸ Dayparting has a new 'Move it day to day by at least', set to 5 hours. A song that aired at 6am can next air before 1am or from noon, instead of merely avoiding 6am itself — which it could satisfy by shifting an hour and still landing inside the same show.

This is for the listener who catches the same programme every day. It looks three days either side, and it understands that the day is a circle: 23:00 and 01:00 are two hours apart, so the overnight is covered too.

It is a preference, not a separation rule: when a rotation cannot satisfy everything it gives way before a song is allowed to repeat, and the log report counts how often it had to. If that count is high, the rotation is too thin to hold five hours and the report says how many songs it would take.

Set it to 0 for the old behaviour — the same clock hour and nothing else.
